content:
As of the latest information available until 2023, "MBU" in TCS (Tata Consultancy Services) typically refers to "Master Business Unit." TCS, which is one of the largest IT services providers globally, organizes its vast array of services and operations into different strategic business units (SBUs) and sometimes refers to them as Master Business Units (MBUs) depending on the source and context.

These MBUs are structured based on various metrics like industry verticals, client segments, technology services, or geographical locations. Each MBU operates as a separate entity within TCS with its management, strategic objectives, and specific focus areas, enabling more focused and effective service delivery and customer engagement. This structure also helps TCS in optimizing resource utilization, focusing on specialized capabilities, and driving innovations tailored to specific market needs.

Please note, organizational structures in large corporations like TCS can be subject to changes and updates for strategic realignment, so it’s always a good idea to check directly from the official resources or recent company announcements for the most accurate and updated information.
